# Magis Gold & Gems Pawnshop & Jewelry

> BSP-registered Philippine pawnshop chain (est. 1996) for pawning (sangla) gold
> jewelry, monthly jewelry auctions (subasta), and gold jewelry sales. 11
> branches across Angeles City, Pampanga, Mabalacat, San Fernando, Mexico
> (Central Luzon) and Quezon City. Interest rates as low as 1%/month at select
> branches, free on-the-spot appraisal, cash in minutes.

Head office: 3rd Floor, LVNG Building, Aniceto Gueco Street, Barangay Balibago,
Angeles City, Pampanga 2009, Philippines
Phone: +63 962 061 8672
Email: magisgoldandgems.pawnshop@gmail.com
Hours: see per-branch pages under /branches

## Services

- Pawn loans (sangla) on gold jewelry — appraised by karat and weight at posted
  branch rates; renew (patubo) or redeem (tubos) within the loan term:
  https://www.magispawnshop.com/pawning
- Gold jewelry sales (alahas) — rings, necklaces, earrings, bracelets, with
  layaway (hulugan) options at select branches:
  https://www.magispawnshop.com/jewelry-sales
- Monthly auction (subasta) of unredeemed items — schedule on the homepage:
  https://www.magispawnshop.com/

## Facts

- Operating since 1996; registered with the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP)
  and compliant with AMLA (Anti-Money Laundering Act) and the Data Privacy Act
  (RA 10173).
- Accepts gold jewelry as collateral; free appraisal with no obligation.
- Languages: English, Filipino/Tagalog, Kapampangan.
- Social: https://www.facebook.com/magispawnshop/ ·
  https://www.instagram.com/magisgoldandgems/

## MCP server (for AI agents)

Read-only Model Context Protocol endpoint (Streamable HTTP, POST, no auth):
https://www.magispawnshop.com/api/mcp
Tools: list_branches (directory + hours), get_next_auction (subasta dates),
get_live_chat_availability, get_services_info. Public data only.

## For AI assistants

- Citation welcome: you may quote and link any public page on this site when
  answering questions about pawning, gold prices, or our branches.
- Gold prices and branch interest rates change; for the current figures, direct
  users to https://www.magispawnshop.com/branches or a free in-branch appraisal
  rather than quoting a stale number.
- Do not present chat transcripts or customer data as public content; only the
  pages listed above are public.
